name: @red-cup-engineering/git-recursive-commit-service
description: Commits a dirty working tree, pushes the current branch, or walks a repository's immediate submodules committing and pushing each dirty one before the parent (innermost out). The git binary is configurable via MANAGED_GIT or --git-bin, defaulting to "git" on PATH; use when a caller needs to save and publish work across a repository and its submodules in one call, with a --dry-run plan available before anything is staged.

scripts.check: node --check src/commit-the-working-tree.mjs && node --check src/push-the-current-branch.mjs && node --check src/commit-a-repository-recursively.mjs && node --check test/commit-a-repository-recursively.test.mjs
